channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: North Palm Beach hosts Fourth of July fireworks and pool party at country club
item.description: North Palm Beach Country Club and The Clubhouse will host a full day of free community activities on July 4, including a pool party, live music, lawn games and fireworks at 9 p.m.

item.title: Juno Beach faces thousands in costs as residents demand fence replacement at JB-7 beach access
item.description: Residents at the Colony Condos say beachgoers have been cutting through their private property since the town removed a fence at the JB-7 public walkway in 2023. The Juno Beach Town Council will take up the fence question during budget discussions July 15.

item.title: Juno Beach fence dispute at JB-7 beach access could cost town thousands
item.description: Residents at the Colony Condos say people using the JB-7 public walkway are cutting through their private property since the town removed the old fence in 2023 for safety reasons.

item.title: Riviera Beach named only Florida city to receive 2026 All-America City Award
item.description: Riviera Beach was selected as one of just 10 communities in the United States to receive the 2026 All-America City Award from the National Civic League, and was the only Florida city to earn the honor this year.

item.description: The Saint Andrew's Scots football program is focused on a state title run this fall after completing last season with a 10-2 record and a district championship. item.title: Martin County Maritime Response Unit deploys two boats with medics for Fourth of July weekend
item.description: Hundreds of boaters hit Martin County waterways Friday to celebrate the Fourth of July weekend. The Martin County Maritime Response Unit will have two boats with medics on standby in the north and south parts of the county.

item.title: Body of missing diver recovered near Fort Pierce Inlet
item.description: Deputies found the body of a missing diver on the Florida coast near Fort Pierce Inlet.

item.title: Fourth of July cookout costs up 4% in Florida as ground beef and strawberries rise
item.description: A Fourth of July cookout for 10 people now costs $73.82, up 4% from last year, according to the American Farm Bureau Federation's Summer Cookout Cost Survey.
